lines.trans: So my grandfather was a hero?
Yes, he was a real war hero.
So I am not a traitor at all!
You are an honest Russian man, Ivan.
Pavel Yuryevich, do you have nothing more to say?
Your grip is strong, just like your grandfather's.
Thank you so very much, Uncle Mitya!
Stay well and never give up!
Ivan, take a look at this phone screen!
What are they showing on the internet there?
There is a video there with your wife Nina!
Give me the phone, I want to look!
People in the town are applauding your victory!

meanings.en: to applaud, to clap in approval

examples.trans: People in the hall are applauding.
The audience applauded for a long time.
We need to do even more.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
We'll upload the video to the internet.

examples.text: В прошлый раз я думала, война началась.
examples.trans: Last time I thought a war had started.

examples.text: Он читает книгу об искусстве войны.
examples.trans: He is reading a book about the art of war.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: a brave person; also the main character of a story

examples.text: У меня дед три года партизанил!
examples.trans: My grandfather was a partisan for three years!
My grandfather lives in the country.

meanings.note: masculine, but declined like a feminine noun in -я
colloquial, as children say; дяди из Москвы = some people from Moscow

examples.trans: I'm with my wife this evening.

meanings.note: что это значит? = what does this mean?
the form значит is used as a linking word

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.
Look it up on the internet.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ dative + infinitive: мне терять нечего = I have nothing to lose

examples.trans: There is nothing to do here.

meanings.note: used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)
to show, to display, to broadcast on TV

examples.text: Его весь день показывают по телевизору.
examples.trans: They show him on TV all day.

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look

meanings.note: also a Russian man (as a noun)
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.
There are a lot of people here.
An image appeared on the screen.
I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
